# Customer as narrator

`customer_support.mm.de_escalation.customer_as_narrator` · v1.0.0 · **draft** · scope **capability** · kind **mental_model**

> The customer is writing an account of this incident that they will tell internally. We are either a character in it or an absence in it.

It reframes what an update is for. The update is not only information transfer — it is material for the story the requester has to tell their own manager, and a customer who has nothing to relay has to invent something, usually about our indifference.
